in_hebrew.name: גרייסאן
in_hebrew.meaning: חסד אלוהים, חן אלוהים, מתנה אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם גרייסאן הוא שילוב של שני ערכים עבריים: חסד ו חן, שפירושם חסד אלוהים ומתנה אלוהים. השם מורכב מיסודות עבריים ויווניים, ומשמעותו קשורה למתנת החסד והחן האלוהיים. השימוש בשם זה נועד להדגיש את הקשר בין האדם לאלוהים ואת המתנה האלוהית של חסד וחן.

in_greek.name: Γκρέισανν
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Γκρέισανν προέρχεται ἀπὸ τὴν σύνθεση δύο λέξεων: Χάρις (χάρις, χάριτος) καὶ ἄννη (ἄνη, ἄνης), ποὺ σημαίνουν Χάρις Θεοῦ καὶ Δωρεὰ Θεοῦ ἀντίστοιχα. Ἡ σημασία τοῦ ονόματος αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν πνευματικὴν παράδοσιν τῆς Ἐκκλησίας συνδέεται μὲ τὴν divine χάριν καὶ τὴν δωρεὰν τῆς πνευματικῆς χαρίτος.

in_latin.name: Graceanna
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Graceanna ex duobus constat: Gratia, quae Divina Gratia interpretatur, et Anna, quae Donum Dei significat. Hoc nomen in traditione christiana ad significandam Dei gratiam et donum refertur. Etymologia nominis Graceanna in linguis hebraea et graeca radicatur, et potestas spiritualis eius in ecclesia christiana valde appreciatur.

in_english.name: Graceanne
in_english.meaning: God's gracious gift, divine favor and grace
in_english.long_meaning: The name Graceanne is a combination of two elements: Grace, derived from the Latin 'gratia,' meaning divine favor or thanks, and Anne, meaning gracious gift or favor. Etymologically, the name roots in Hebrew and Greek, signifying a gift from God or divine grace. Historically, the name reflects the Christian tradition of acknowledging God's grace and favor. Spiritually, it represents a personality that embodies gratitude, kindness, and generosity. In modern Christian cultures, Graceanne symbolizes a blessed and cherished individual.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Graceanne" is a beautiful and unique combination of the names "Grace" and "Anne." The name "Grace" itself is deeply ingrained in Western culture, representing the Christian virtue of kindness, elegance, and mercy given by God. The name "Anne," which means "grace" in Hebrew, further accentuates the meaning of the name "Graceanne." It is a name that reminds us of the importance of God's blessings and favor in our lives.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Graceanne" holds significant spiritual meaning in the Christian faith. The name "Grace" is often associated with God's unmerited favor towards humanity. The name "Anne," which also means "grace," emphasizes the idea that it is through God's grace that we are saved and able to live our lives. The name "Graceanne" reminds us of the importance of receiving and extending God's grace in our lives, and of the source of all true grace - God Himself.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Grace, Anne" symbolizes Grace: God's favor, Anne: Grace, God's grace.. In Christian spirituality, bearing the name Graceanne serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual calling and connection to Christian values of grace, anne.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Elizabeth Graceanne in Athens, Greece credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Graceanne, which means "Grace, Anne". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
